paragraphs: The “Food & Beverages” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Food & Beverages, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Beverages, Cannabis Products, Food Items, Tobacco Products.

Choose Food & Beverages when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Food & Beverages before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
